Punjab CM Denies Paper Leaks Amid Opposition Demands

Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann stated that no paper leak incidents have occurred during his government's 4.5-year tenure. This statement came in response to allegations of paper leaks and demands for the resignation of Education Minister Harjot Singh Bains from opposition parties including the BJP, Congress, and SAD. Mann asserted that his government has taken action against cheating gangs.
